case_title: Tukaram & Ors. v. State of Maharashtra
statutory_provisions: IPC s. 326, s. 34; IPC s. 304(1) read with s. 149
trial_court_outcome: Convicted under Sections 302/149 etc. of the IPC and sentenced to various terms of imprisonment
high_court_outcome: Conviction confirmed, sentence modified to one under Section 304(1) read with Section 149 of the IPC
neutral_facts: The accused and the complainant were part of two different groups in an organization called the Dalit Mukti Sena. They were invited to a marriage and after the ceremony, the deceased was returning home with friends. The accused followed them and attacked the deceased with fists and iron rods, causing grievous injuries. The deceased was taken to the hospital where initial medical examination revealed an injury on the buttocks. Over the following days, the deceased's condition deteriorated, and internal injuries were discovered, leading to multiple operations and ultimately the deceased's death. The medical evidence indicated that the initial examination did not fully account for the severity of the injuries, and the accused were convicted of causing grievous harm.
